sources.name: chinese_names_corpus_gender
sources.notes: 1.2 million common Chinese full names with binary gender labels. Used as the sole redistributable attested-name source for the shipped dataset. Given names are derived by stripping surnames; raw 120万 file is not committed. Ancient-name files from this repo are not ingested.

formulas.gender: maleScore = male/(male+female); femaleScore = female/(male+female); neutralScore = 1 - abs(maleScore - femaleScore); null if no gendered counts
